text:
You stand in a quiet village square.
The wind carries the smell of bread from a nearby bakery.

You have looked around {lookCounter} times.

An elderly villager pauses near the stone well and nods at you.

"Fresh loaves just came out of the oven, traveler.
Stay safe if you head past the eastern woods."
Shadows stir along the overgrown path as two goblins leap out from behind the trees!

Dappled sunlight filters through the tall pines of the eastern woods.
The forest path is quiet now, with only the scattered gear of defeated goblins left behind.
